title: Nonparametric estimation of time-varying network connections by multi-stage smoothing
abstract: arXiv:2605.06862v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We consider the problem of estimating the underlying edge probabilities of a time-varying network observed at multiple time points. The probability structure is represented by a time-varying graphon that satisfies temporal H\"older smoothness and piecewise Lipschitz conditions in the latent variables. We propose a multi-stage smoothing estimator that first applies temporal local smoothing to each edge and then performs node-domain smoothing using a data-driven neighborhood construction adapted from the method. An additional temporal smoothing step is introduced as an optional refinement when uniform accuracy over the entire time domain is required. Simulation studies demonstrate the benefits of combining temporal and node-domain smoothing under different generative models. translated_title: 基于多阶段平滑的时变网络连接非参数估计
translated_abstract: 我们考虑估计在多个时间点上观测的时变网络的潜在边概率问题。该概率结构由一个时变图函数表示，其在时间维度上满足Hölder光滑性条件，并在潜变量上满足分段Lipschitz条件。我们提出了一种多阶段平滑估计方法，首先对每条边应用时间局部平滑，然后使用从该方法改编的数据驱动邻域构造进行节点域平滑。当需要在整个时间域上保持一致精度时，还引入了额外的时间平滑步骤作为可选的改进。模拟研究展示了在不同生成模型下结合时间平滑与节点域平滑的优势。我们还将该方法应用于真实的时变网络数据集，结果表明该方法能够同时捕捉连接中的平滑时间演化特征和结构模式。
tldr: 本文提出一种多阶段平滑估计方法，通过结合时间局部平滑与数据驱动的节点域平滑来非参数估计时变网络的边概率，能够同时捕捉网络连接的平滑时间演化与结构模式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-stage smoothing estimator that combines temporal local smoothing with data-driven node-domain smoothing to nonparametrically estimate edge probabilities of time-varying networks, capturing both smooth temporal evolution and structural connection patterns.
